title: Andrew Price - Improving Blender's UI
summary: Andrew Price presents at the Blender conference on the problems, politics and possible fixes for Blender's user interface, followed by a full Q&A. He argues that an interface upgrade is overdue.
why: Cited as an example of how hard it is to reconcile UX views in open source communities, and as the start of a redesign discussion.

quote.text: Andrew Price explains better in his talk about Blender redesing than I could
